Qudora Technologies

quantum-vendor · computing-hardware · Braunschweig, Germany · https://qudora.com/

מכונות באטלס (2)

  • XAPHIRO (QUDORA 50-qubit NFQC prototype for the DLR Quantum Computing Initiative) — ANNOUNCED (under construction: first ion trapped 4 Jun 2025; >=50 fully functional qubits due by project end 31 Jan 2027; emulator on DLR QCI Connect), Jun 2025 (first ion); Jan 2027 (project end)
  • NFQC-1k — PLANNED (five-year project; fault-tolerant machine by 2030), 1,000 q, Sep 2026
